description: The hosts of the mesh as Baude's, Record's and the phone's windows show them: each one's state, its right-click menu, and its daemon's restart (the line at the foot of the list while one is pending, and what it waits for).

messages.down: Can't connect to {$host} at the moment
messages.down_because: Can't connect to {$host} at the moment: {$why}
messages.restart_waiting: .input {$n :number} .match $n one {{Restarting the daemon once {$n} thing is done}} * {{Restarting the daemon once {$n} things are done}}
messages.no_commands: {$host} has no Baude commands yet: run `python3 baude_headless.py install` in its Baude checkout there
